source.shard_selection: _load_cells keeps configs in CONFIGS_BY_GROUP['S3'] (neg_mamba, gate_token) that have R_ro_t, M_ro_t and mp > 0. crossing_cells then keeps the runs with a T_cross crossing, which are the runs drawn and correlated. The other shards are mamba_tanhA / mamba_freeA runs not in this figure

definitions.q: q_t = R_ro(t) / M_ro(t) per run, unsmoothed: R_ro = mean over 200 rollouts of the readout-space distance to the class centroid, M_ro = minimum pairwise centroid distance. Linearly interpolated (np.interp over finite, positive steps) onto x = t / mp; null outside the run's range.
definitions.mpcoarse: x is normalised by mp, the coarse max-passing length from training evaluation (lengths 60, 100, 200, ..., 1000; accuracy > 90%). The sibling figure without '_mpcoarse' uses fine_mp (first step where the 50-step rolling rollout accuracy drops below 0.9).
definitions.t_cross: first t >= warmup at which the 50-step rolling means give R_ro/M_ro >= tau for k_consec consecutive steps. Runs that never cross within T = 1500 are neither drawn nor correlated, so every exported run has a T_cross.
definitions.median: per-family np.nanmedian over that family's exported runs at each x.

ylim_note: y limits are matplotlib autoscale over all plotted lines

correlation.method: Pearson r of (log T_cross, log mp); two-sided t-test, df = N - 2
